Position Summary Position: Community Health Worker Location: Field 75% or more of the time in Essex County, NJ Schedule: Mon-Fri 08:0-05:00 PM EST The Community Health Worker (CHW) will support the implementation of the CHW Pilot designed to address health disparities, improve outcomes, and reduce avoidable utilization among Medicaid members with Type 2 diabetes. This role is critical in addressing identified needs, including high diabetes prevalence and significant social determinants of health (SDoH) risk within targeted counties. The CHW will engage directly with members to improve self-management, enhance access to care and community resources, and support overall health outcomes through culturally appropriate, community-based interventions. The CHW will serve as a liaison between members, the care management team, providers, and community resources, with a focus on improving member experience, increasing primary care engagement, and reducing emergency department and inpatient utilization. Position Responsibilities Conduct telephonic, virtual, and face-to-face outreach and engagement with assigned members. Maintain an active caseload (approximately up to 30 members), with engagement duration based on member needs. Complete required screenings and assessments, including initial engagement and health equity screeners within required timeframes. Develop and implement individualized action plans in collaboration with members and interdisciplinary care teams. Provide education and support related to Type 2 diabetes management, including medication adherence, nutrition, physical activity, and lifestyle behaviors. Identify and address gaps in care, supporting members in completing recommended preventive and follow-up services. Connect members to community-based resources addressing SDoH needs (e.g., food, housing, transportation) and ensure closed-loop referral follow-up. Assist members in navigating healthcare services, including scheduling and attending primary and specialty care appointments. Participate in interdisciplinary team meetings and case rounds to support care coordination. Document all member interactions, outreach attempts, and interventions in designated systems in accordance with program requirements. Support member engagement in pilot initiatives and services, including education programs, community events, and resource utilization. Promote positive member relationships and culturally competent care aligned with community needs. Required Qualifications Experience working in community health, social services, care management, or related field. Experience engaging with underserved or high-risk populations. Strong communication, interpersonal, and engagement skills. Ability to build trust and maintain relationships with diverse populations. Knowledge of community resources and SDoH-related services. Ability to manage a caseload and document activities accurately. Must live in Essex County or nearby License / Credential Requirements Community Health Worker (CHW) Certification from the NJ Department of Health (or must obtain within 12 months of employment date). Preferred Qualifications Lived experience or prior work supporting individuals with Type 2 diabetes or chronic conditions. Experience working within Medicaid or managed care environments. Bilingual or multilingual skills aligned with community served. Familiarity with care management systems and electronic health records. Knowledge of motivational interviewing, cultural competency, and trauma-informed care practices. Education Required High school diploma or equivalent required Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Public Health, Social Work, or related field preferred. Scale is building AI for the world’s most important decisions. From the front lines of homeland security to the core of global enterprise, we provide the data engine and agentic infrastructure that powers the next generation of American and allied interests.
As a Deployment Strategist supporting DHS and DOJ, you will be responsible for bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI research and mission-critical production. You will lead the charge in deploying Agentic AI, autonomous reasoning systems, into the heart of homeland security and law enforcement workflows, ensuring that some of the nation’s most consequential decisions are supported by the world’s best technology.
Deployment Strategist (DHS/DOJ)
We are looking for a powerhouse executive account leader who understands that winning at DHS and DOJ isn’t about a successful 6-month pilot; it’s about becoming an enduring, funded capability inside a component’s operational baseline. You will focus on landing and transitioning high-stakes prototypes into full-scale enterprise deployments, navigating the complexities of the Valley of Death by securing executive sponsorship and programmed funding.
Responsibilities:
This is an individual contributor role with heavy leadership expectations. You are the "CEO of the Account," responsible for the following:
Full-Spectrum Capture & Quota Ownership: Carry and exceed a multi-million dollar annual revenue quota. You are responsible for the entire lifecycle: from identifying the top of funnel opportunity and shaping requirements to the final contract award and revenue recognition.
Tactical Execution: You don’t just delegate; you execute. You will personally draft high-impact white papers, lead the development of complex proposals, architect deal structures, and navigate the nuances of federal civilian contracting, including OTAs, GSA schedules, and component-specific IDIQ vehicles.
Operational Transition: Once the deal is signed, your job isn’t over. You will continue to lead the account, ensuring that the delivery team (Engagement Managers, Technical PMs, Engineers, and Product) enables mission success. You are the primary point of contact for the customer, ensuring the pilot doesn’t just work, but scales.
Renewal, Expansion, & Growth: Own the long-term account strategy. You are responsible for identifying the next use case, securing the follow-on funding, and driving the 10x growth that turns a single component deployment into a department-wide enterprise standard.
Direct Agentic Solutioning: Work in the weeds with technical teams and end-users to co-design Agentic AI workflows. You must be able to translate a customer’s vision into a specific technical requirement that our engineers can build against.
SI & Prime Orchestration: In partnership with Scale’s Partner Managers, you will actively manage and negotiate with Tier 1 Systems Integrators and federal primes to ensure Scale is the agentic AI engine of their larger programs. You will be the lead negotiator for sub-contracting and teaming agreements.
Requirements:
Experience: 10+ years of experience in complex enterprise IT sales or business development, specifically within DHS, DOJ, or the broader federal law enforcement and homeland security market.
Proven Track Record: You have successfully closed and implemented multi-year deals exceeding $25M. You know how to get a line item in the budget.
Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of DHS and DOJ modernization priorities, specifically in AI/ML, computer vision, biometrics, screening and vetting, investigative analytics, or case management.
The Valley of Death Navigator: You have a demonstrated ability to transition technology from "cool demo" to "deployed capability" within a major component program office.
Strategic Network: Existing high-level relationships across DHS and DOJ components (CBP, ICE, USCIS, TSA, CISA, FBI, DEA, ATF, USMS) and their CIO and enterprise IT organizations, as well as a Rolodex of contacts at the major federal integrators.
Clearance: Active Secret clearance is strongly preferred; TS/SCI and existing component suitability are a plus.
Education: BS/BA required; technical degree or MBA preferred.
Geography: Based in the National Capital Region, with the ability to work out of Scale’s D.C. office 2-3 days a week.
Travel: Ability to travel 20-30% of the time.
Who you are:
Mission-Driven: You believe that whoever wins in AI wins the next century, and you want that to be the United States and its allies.
Relentless: You thrive in the long-game of defense procurement. You aren't discouraged by bureaucracy; you see it as a puzzle to be solved.
Adaptive: You can operate in the high-velocity environment of a Series E startup while maintaining the polish required for the Pentagon.
The Closer-Operator: You have the executive presence to brief a PEO.
Radically Accountable: You don't wait for a marketing lead or a BD specialist to hand you a deal. You build your own funnel, navigate the "No's," and find the creative path to "Yes."
Technically Credible: You aren't a software engineer, but you can explain the difference between RAG and Agentic reasoning to a skeptical technical evaluator.

jobs.description: Leaders are owners. They think long term for our customers and don’t sacrifice long-term value for short-term results. Amazon Freight Europe is looking for just such an owner to lead the strategy for our externalized freight business to design and deliver a world class freight experience for our business customers. ABOUT THIS ROLE The Head of Strategy will report directly into the leader of the Amazon Freight Europe business to lead and build out the newly created Strategy team across Europe (including UK). They will be based in Luxembourg, London or Munich to tackle the most hotly debated topics within our startup organization. They will partner closely with Product, Program, Operations and Commercial leaders to identify the challenges and opportunities in our organization, and come up with creative, customer-driven solutions to solve them. The Head of Strategy will work across both the European business and worldwide tech domains to shape our long-term business plan, diving deep with leaders across multiple areas to define customer problems and deliver the solutions. ABOUT YOU You’re a self-described ‘builder’ and ‘fixer’ with a passion for figuring out what the future looks like. You have a relentless focus on creating and improving customer value. You’re a hands-on multitasker who can quickly change focus and balance the needs of the moment with longer-term goals. You have a high tolerance for ambiguity and complexity. You have resilience and a positive, solutions-oriented attitude – even the toughest challenges are possible with the right amount of creativity, good judgment and hard work. You have strong problem solving, communication and organizational skills and the ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority, along with a good understanding of product development/management and digital media. You’re a leader with a blend of strategy, product management and/or operations experience and have the business acumen to understand and shape Amazon Freight’s business-wide roadmap. You achieve your results through other people, often without authority, making complex decisions simple through data and inspire people at all levels in the organization. You proactively identify gaps and risks, and partner with senior leaders in and out of the organization to define creative solutions to solve them. You embody the rare combination of thinker and doer. YOU WILL. -Partner with Product, Program, Operations and Commercial teams to oversee strategic business initiatives from development through to successful execution, ensuring that individual function targets are in harmony and resolving those that aren’t. Support colleagues in their decision-making, program management, and initiative implementation, calling out opportunities to double-down and the unseen risks. -Review, design, and execute improvements to organizational structure; find knowledge and skills gaps and help address them. -Improve current processes and review organization-wide procedures for efficiency and productivity. -Control the output of shared-services functions to ensure that outsourced tasks deliver to the high expectations of our Amazon Freight customers. Key job responsibilities •Ensure department goals are well integrated with each other and control organization-wide success, identifying areas to invest, double down or repair. •Influence wider Amazon teams to secure collaborative, efficient solutions for our customers, re-using existing capabilities wherever possible. •Build long term strategic plans, working alongside our product team, who specifies new products and features, our tech team that builds them, our operations that deliver them, our commercial team that sells them as well as the Amazon Freight teams outside EU. •Stay close to the operational realities of our business, recognizing that what we will build has its foundation in the work of our Associates and partners on sites and in vehicles. •This includes organizational design to help build our future team structures whilst securing support to our team for new hires, including documentation, onboarding, and learning and development team. •Develop and build relationships with all employees for increased efficiency and responsiveness of existing operations, and help define new operational strategies by working with EU AF Director and other executives on special projects. A day in the life - Build relationships with our customers (shippers). - Coach and mentor business developers within the team. - Define business development KPIs targets and manage performance against these KPIs. - Dive deep into shippers' requirements and pain points to find solutions. About the team At Amazon Freight, we blend advanced technology with Amazon's network of 6,500+ owned trailers and 13,000+ trusted carrier partners across UK & EU to move freight-simply and reliably. We apply the same customer obsession that we are known for in the consumer business to the Business to Business segment, aiming to partner with our customers to meet the demands of today while helping to navigate the road ahead. The team is diverse and intercultural with passionate members with a team-focused attitude. Across Amazon, we have committed to reach net-zero carbon by 2040, ten years ahead of the Paris Agreement and we take this commitment seriously in Amazon Freight too. We’re not there yet but if this sounds interesting, maybe you can help us get there.

Overview
The
Supervisor, Activation – Search, Social, and Programmatic
is responsible for developing and leading the paid search, paid social, and programmatic media approach and executing these tactics via multiple search, social, and programmatic channels for Universal Pictures campaigns.
As the Supervisor, Activation, you will be responsible for the day-to-day management, quality assurance, and execution of Universal’s paid search, social, and programmatic advertising initiatives across the Performance vertical. This role involves guiding the team through campaign builds and post-analysis, evaluating vendors, managing internal/external timelines, and maintaining strong relationships with clients, leadership, and media partners.
YOUR IMPACT
Accountabilities
Guide Performance team in the planning and execution of media strategies and recommendations for Universal campaigns
Oversee campaigns for all film titles across Performance vertical from initial build through post analysis
Responsible for team’s day-to-day maintenance of Performance plans for all film titles
Manage the team’s work within individual tactical documents (ie. Creative Deadlines, Plan Details, Inputs Tabs, Airtable)
In-depth check for accuracy and quality assurance of all documents and executions pertaining to Performance
Provide evidence of rigorous evaluation of recommended vendors/tactics
Include commentary on cost analysis, performance benchmarks, audience reach/scale and capabilities of partners/platforms that are recommended as well as those considered, but not recommended
React to performance of media proactively and in real time
Minimize executional errors, including timely launches, campaign pacing and spending of campaign budgets
Communicate updates to AMD and Directors immediately
Manage internal timelines to meet external deadlines
Allocate adequate time for senior review and feedback of the team’s work prior to delivery to Universal
Participate in the creation and delivery of thought pieces (POVs)
Relationships & Communication
Attend and participate in Universal/agency meetings
Manage and maintain relationships with external partners (ie. media vendors)
Understand the media landscape and meet with vendors to proactively keep abreast of trends
Support Universal email/phone communication as necessary and required
Effectively communicate with leadership team (AMD and up) and direct reports to maintain efficient workflow
Team
Backup Activation Director and Activation planning team during periods of personal time off/open roles
Collaborate with other Managers/Supervisors to build holistic strategies and plans
Manage the day to day workload of planners and assistant
Provide constructive feedback to planner and assistant level team members in a timely manner
Effectively solve problems, escalating media or billing issues when necessary
YOUR QUALIFICATIONS
Hands-on experience planning, executing, and managing multi-channel biddable campaigns across Paid Social (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Snap), Programmatic (The Trade Desk), and Paid Search (Google Ads).
Knowledge of paid search, paid social, and programmatic platforms/DSPs (Google Ads, Facebook/Instagram, Snap, TikTok, YouTube, The Trade Desk).
Minimum of 4-5 years of paid social, programmatic, and/or paid search experience in an agency environment.
Proven experience managing and delegating workloads to direct reports (Planners and Assistants) and providing timely performance feedback.
High confidence and professional demeanor when communicating and building relationships with clients in a fast-paced environment.
Passion for and awareness of pop culture, entertainment, and current film landscape.
Exceptional attention to detail, organizational skills, and QA standards.
High level of technical proficiency in Microsoft Office, specifically Excel and PowerPoint, as well as workflow tools like Airtable.

jobs.description: We consider applications for this position on an ongoing basis. OVERVIEW Experience a perfect blend of deliberate purpose and clear-eyed vision. At Ulta Beauty, some of the industry’s most highly-esteemed beauty leaders share themselves, as well as their expertise. Building authentic community. Creating a real sense of belonging —even as they’re plotting a bold, strategic course of exciting innovations destined to revolutionize the industry. Think robust organizational support. The Stylist delivers quality professional services with an emphasis on the guest’s total look. They support the Experience Manager (EM) and the Assistant Services Manager (ASM) through a focus on performance (service sales, and productivity), people (guest service), and process (operating procedures and compliance standards). Meet or exceed sales goal of $800 average weekly sales and productivity goals for hair services by delivering exceptional guest service and contribute to meeting or exceeding the store’s goals related to retail and service sales, guest loyalty (including credit), and retail shrink as set by Ulta Beauty. Demonstrate business acumen with understanding of business drivers and identified opportunities for growth. Perform product demonstrations with guests to drive sales and the guest service experience. Support the execution of in-store events, promotions, and marketing-initiatives that deliver an unrivaled guest experience. Take the initiative to stay informed regarding new and existing industry trends, products, and services during work time, and be knowledgeable about the ingredients and benefits of these trends, products, and services to better serve guests. Maintain prompt, regular attendance. People Develop guest relationships through consultations and appropriate retail and service recommendations. Demonstrate high standards of customer service and salon image standards. Serve all guests, including walk-in guests, in a timely and efficient manner. Develop a partnership with skin therapists and the retail team to provide a total-store and well- rounded guest experience. Establish professional peer and brand partner relationships that foster a shared interest in collaboratively delivering exceptional guest service. Share the benefits of the guest loyalty program, including credit and the Ulta Beauty app, with guests in the salon and on the salesfloor. Follow established service protocols to ensure a consistent and exceptional guest experience. Utilize appropriate booking and clientele systems to book guests for return services and for events. Communicate any supply needs to the EM, ensuring guest readiness at all times. Maintain outstanding store operational standards, including cleanliness of the salon, salesfloor, restrooms, backroom, break area, and any additional assigned area. Adhere to the Ulta Beauty dress code. Protect company assets by following loss prevention best practices and providing exceptional guest service. Execute other operational tasks as directed. JOB QUALIFICATIONS Education Cosmetology license Experience Previous relevant salon experience is preferred. Skills Proficiency with latest salon techniques for performing haircutting, haircolor, lightening, styling, texture, treatment, extensions, makeup, and ear piercing services (where applicable) and/or an aptitude to develop skills and capabilities in all service categories. Proficiency with use of equipment and chemicals needed to perform technical work Proficiency to demonstrate, recommend and sell pro hair care and makeup products Developed communication skills Ability to work independently and as part of a team Ability to build and maintain strong customer relationships, and build clientele SPECIAL POSITION REQUIREMENTS Work a flexible schedule to include days, evenings, weekends, and holidays WORKING CONDITIONS Frequent mobility during shift Continuous lifting and/or moving up to 10 lbs. during shift Frequent stooping, kneeling, bending, reaching, twisting, and crouching during shift Ability to stand for long periods of time during shift Continuous and/or frequent coordination and manipulation of objects during shift If an associate has a disability that prevents them from performing an essential function of the job, the Company will engage in the interactive process with the associate to determine whether there is a reasonable accommodation that will enable the associate to perform the essential functions of the job. ABOUT At Ulta Beauty (NASDAQ: ULTA), the possibilities are beautiful . Ulta Beauty is the largest North American beauty retailer and the premier beauty destination for cosmetics, fragrance, skin care products, hair care products and salon services. We bring possibilities to life through the power of beauty each and every day in our stores and online with more than 25,000 products from approximately 500 well-established and emerging beauty brands across all categories and price points, including Ulta Beauty’s own private label. jobs.description: Amazon seeks exceptional leaders for a strategic senior management position overseeing our data center operations. This executive role offers significant visibility within the organization and aligns with our mission of becoming the world's most customer-centric company. This leader will direct managers responsible for mission-critical data center infrastructure, manage network systems, server operations, and infrastructure maintenance, and ensure optimal availability and performance across multiple regional facilities. Requirements include proven leadership in complex data center environments, technical expertise in enterprise-scale operations, and a track record of operational excellence. This senior leadership position is critical to our Data Center Community's success. The ideal candidate will possess comprehensive knowledge of both data center IT infrastructure and AWS cloud platforms, with a clear understanding of their integration and interoperability. Experience demonstrating practical applications of these technologies in hybrid environments is highly valued. If you are passionate about Customer Experience, think and act globally and want to contribute to the operational excellence of Amazon.com data centers. This may be the challenge you’ve been looking for! AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. Key job responsibilities - Lead and supervise a team of Data Center Managers (3-9 areas and front-line managers) and 100-150 hourly associates within Regional Data Centers. - Attainment of organizational performance goals and objectives relating to safety, security, availability, scaling, and efficiency in support of our data center operations. - Carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization’s policies and procedures. - Accountability for meeting and exceeding operational goals. - Strategic planning and forecasting; appraise performance; reward and discipline employees; resolve problems; and address staffing needs. - Obsess over team learning and development, both from a technical/functional and soft skills (critical thinking, emotional intelligence, and adaptability) development perspective including mentoring and training. - Develop, improve, and share operational best practices across the globe. - Hiring, managing, and developing the operations management team including data center managers and data center operations technicians. Planning and executing the Infrastructure Operations component of new AWS data center buildouts, new colocation buildouts, AWS data center expansions, and colocation expansions, including the network and server rack infrastructure to facilitate the daily operations. - Experience in successful insourcing and/or outsourcing specific tasks balancing internal skillsets with frugality. - Continuous improvement of operational processes, procedures, methods, and tools. This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational. Essential Requirements: - Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed - Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational - Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

jobs.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. THE ROLE We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to partner with Mistral's code and vibe research team - the researchers shaping how our models write, reason about, and play with code. You'll be their operational counterpart - the person who absorbs what the team is working on and makes it legible to the team, to leadership, and to adjacent teams. This isn't a coordination role. It's a research partnership role - embedded with the team, fluent in what they're building, and operationally responsible for everything that isn't the science itself. The ideal candidate is someone who is genuinely excited about code models. You play with them. You have opinions about what makes them feel good to use. You read the papers because you want to, not because you have to. A research background is a plus but not required - what matters is that you care about this domain and can hold your own in a room full of researchers working on it. Make the research legible to adjacent teams and leadership without pulling researchers into status work. - Operational Partnership: Be the team's operational partner. Handle the coordination, resourcing, and cross-team conversations that would otherwise sit on researchers' plates - so the team can stay focused on the science. - Research-to-release: Own the operational path from research work to release candidate for code and vibe workstreams. Partner with the release function to ensure the team's work flows cleanly into Mistral's release machinery. - Visibility & Communication Cadence: Code and vibe research connects to many other efforts across the organization. Keep these interfaces clean and high-signal, so the team's work integrates naturally with the wider science org. - Strategic Communication: Translate the team's work into clear, well-timed updates for leadership and adjacent teams - what's being built, what matters, what's coming next.
